integrity: Direct analytic graph proof; independent validation and publication priority not established. Supplementary finite checker supports but does not establish the all-n theorem.
scientific_limitations: Real scalars; codimension one; finite p unequal to 2 only. No higher-codimension or complex-space classification. Earlier equivalent combinatorial formulations remain possible.
title: The topology of real codimension-one isometric embeddings in \(\ell^p\)
